# The Duskbloods Guide

> Unofficial fan information hub for The Duskbloods — a multiplayer PvPvE action game by FromSoftware and Hidetaka Miyazaki for Nintendo Switch 2, targeting a 2026 release. Covers release date tracking, gameplay systems, the Bloodsworn roster, map and kin guides, and network test history.

This site is not affiliated with or endorsed by FromSoftware or Nintendo. All game content belongs to its respective owners.

Editorial independence: official screenshots and system facts are credited to FromSoftware / Nintendo. Rankings, analysis, and recommendations are independent fan work. See [About](https://duskbloods.net/about) and [Privacy Policy](https://duskbloods.net/privacy).

## Core pages

- [Release Date](https://duskbloods.net/release-date): Current status of The Duskbloods release date — official 2026 window, delay watch, and tracker analysis.
- [Gameplay](https://duskbloods.net/gameplay): Full mechanics guide — Dusk Battle flow, Virtue system, combat, alliances, sigils, and tips.
- [Characters](https://duskbloods.net/characters): The six playable Bloodsworn in the network test — weapons, Bloodsworn Skills, and Aspects.
- [Maps](https://duskbloods.net/maps): Lands of Dusk guide — Lowanro City layout, regional features, and map tools.
- [Kin](https://duskbloods.net/kin): Kin compacts explained — summoning circles (Ring, Blade, Eye), kin types, and growth rules.
- [Network Test](https://duskbloods.net/network-test): Closed network test recap — schedule, registration results, and server issues.
- [FAQ](https://duskbloods.net/faq): Frequently asked questions about the game and this site.
- [Latest News](https://duskbloods.net/latest): Dated news and analysis articles.
- [Guides](https://duskbloods.net/guides): Evergreen guides — tier lists, weapons, maps, mechanics, comparisons.

## Locales

English is served without a path prefix. Other languages use a locale prefix: `/ja`, `/zh`, `/zh-TW`, `/es`, `/fr`, `/de`, `/ko`, `/it`, `/pt`, `/ru` (for example, `https://duskbloods.net/zh/gameplay`).

- [About](https://duskbloods.net/about): About this fan site, editorial policy, and independence.
- [Gallery](https://duskbloods.net/gallery): Official screenshots and artwork with independent breakdowns.
